== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-lukeshuntingrifle-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Luke's Hunting Rifle]] (Decipher; Decipher's [[Luke's Hunting Rifle (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes: “any” becomes “your”; “character (even if not a warrior).” becomes “character.”; “a character or creature” is added after “warrior). May target”; “Character” becomes “Subtract 1 if targeting a character. Add 2 if targeting a creature. Target”; “total” is added after “Character hit if”; “-1 > ability. Creature immediately lost if destiny +2” is dropped. These are the same words as [[Luke's Hunting Rifle (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Luke's Hunting Rifle” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
